# isidore

> Software projects need a guide that explains how they are built, and those guides go out of date the moment the work changes.

Documentation compiled by isidore from this repository's structure. Every page ships a `.cert.json` recording which of its statements were mechanically verified against the code.

## Start here

- [overview.md](wiki/overview.md): what this project is, in plain language

- [subsystem-src.md](wiki/subsystem-src.md)
